title: Guarded HCL RunnerBinding v0.1
description: Audit/provenance binding between one candidate identifier, one exact artifact identity, and one Selection Receipt identity. This document is not authorization, activation, or a signature.

candidateId.description: Opaque, case-sensitive candidate or service identifier containing Unicode scalar values only. No trimming or Unicode normalization is applied.

profile.description: Exact artifact digest profile selected by RunnerBinding v0.1.

kind.description: Artifact representation from the named profile; tree and blob identities are domain-separated.

digest.description: Digest of the exact artifact manifest produced under profile and kind.

schemaUri.description: Exact schema identifier under the RunnerBinding v0.1 lexical profile: lowercase https with a lowercase DNS-like host and optional canonical decimal port 1-65535, or lowercase urn with a lowercase namespace; ASCII path/query/fragment characters and valid percent escapes only. The value is never normalized or resolved.

digestProfile.description: Receipt JSON is parsed as I-JSON and digested after RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization.

digest.description: Digest of the exact Selection Receipt JSON document under digestProfile.
